==Location and Uses==
==={{OoT|-}}===
{{Descriptions OoT}}
The Goron Tunic is a red tunic that is able to protect its wearer from extreme heat, made from [[Dodongo]] scales and [[Bomb Flower]] fibers.<ref>{{Cite Web|quote= Fashioned from a sporty blend of Dodongo hide and Bomb Flower fibers, the Goron Tunic allowed Link to survive the intense heat generated within Death Mountain Crater. |url= http://web.archive.org/web/20160308195651/http://zelda.com/universe/pedia/g.jsp |title= The Great Hyrule Encyclopedia |site=Zelda.com |type= jsp}}</ref> It can only be worn by [[Link]] as an adult.<ref>{{Cite|You got a {{Color OoT3D|Red|Goron Tunic}}! This heat-resistant tunic is adult sized, so it won't fit a kid. Going to a hot place? No worries!|Game Screen|OoT3D}}</ref> The Goron Tunic is essential when exploring places such as the [[Death Mountain Crater]] and the [[Fire Temple (Ocarina of Time)|Fire Temple]]. While wearing it, Link will no longer burn from fire-based traps and attacks and will be able to travel on tiles of lava, allowing him to take certain shortcuts safely. He will also gain special resistance from floor spikes and poison water. The tunic can be stolen by a [[Like Like]] if Link is still wearing it when the Like Like spits him out.

It can be bought in the [[Goron Shop]] for 600 [[Rupee]]s.{{Note|In {{OoT3D}} and the [[Nintendo 64]] version of {{OoT}}, the Goron Tunic costs 200 Rupees instead.}} Alternatively, Link can obtain it for free as a gift from [[Link (Goron)|Darunia's son]] after stopping him from rolling around [[Goron City]].<ref name="OoT Link"/>
